description: Welcome to the Jammu Smart City Hackathon - by LEAD!: A hackathon experience for team-based coding and problem-solving. About the Opportunity: The Jammu Smart City Hackathon, organized by LEAD, is a hackathon structured as an online coding challenge and listed in offline mode. It offers teams an opportunity to engage with coding-focused challenges in a collaborative format. As a team-participation opportunity, it encourages participants to bring together their coding abilities, ideas, and collaborative energy. Take on the challenge with your team and turn your problem-solving skills into action. Bring your team and take the next step with the Jammu Smart City Hackathon by LEAD. Jammu Smart City Hackathon (JSCH) is an innovation platform initiated by Jammu Smart City Limited in collaboration with LEAD – LJK Economic Growth & Development Dialogue. The hackathon brings together innovators, entrepreneurs, researchers, startups, NGOs, social enterprises and community organizations to develop practical solutions to the urban challenges faced by Jammu. The hackathon is designed to move beyond ideas by creating a structured pathway from problem identification, ideation, mentoring and solution refinement to final evaluation and potential implementation. Participants will have the opportunity to work on real civic challenges and develop solutions that are innovative, scalable, sustainable and implementable. Themes / Problem Statements: Participants can submit solutions under the following six broad categories: Urban Planning, Green Spaces & Public Realm Cleanliness, Waste Management & Sustainability Digital Governance, Mobility & Smart Infrastructure Tourism, Heritage & Culture Welfare of All Urban Resilience & Disaster Management Open Innovation Track: Every category remains open beyond the listed challenges. Participants may propose any relevant idea within the same theme, even if it is not explicitly listed among the problem statements.

raw.details:
Welcome to the Jammu Smart City Hackathon - by LEAD!:

A hackathon experience for team-based coding and problem-solving.

About the Opportunity:

The Jammu Smart City Hackathon, organized by LEAD, is a hackathon structured as an online coding challenge and listed in offline mode. It offers teams an opportunity to engage with coding-focused challenges in a collaborative format.

As a team-participation opportunity, it encourages participants to bring together their coding abilities, ideas, and collaborative energy. Take on the challenge with your team and turn your problem-solving skills into action.

Bring your team and take the next step with the Jammu Smart City Hackathon by LEAD.

Jammu Smart City Hackathon (JSCH) is an innovation platform initiated by Jammu Smart City Limited in collaboration with LEAD – LJK Economic Growth & Development Dialogue. The hackathon brings together innovators, entrepreneurs, researchers, startups, NGOs, social enterprises and community organizations to develop practical solutions to the urban challenges faced by Jammu.

The hackathon is designed to move beyond ideas by creating a structured pathway from problem identification, ideation, mentoring and solution refinement to final evaluation and potential implementation. Participants will have the opportunity to work on real civic challenges and develop solutions that are innovative, scalable, sustainable and implementable.

Themes / Problem Statements:

Participants can submit solutions under the following six broad categories:

  • Urban Planning, Green Spaces & Public Realm
  • Cleanliness, Waste Management & Sustainability
  • Digital Governance, Mobility & Smart Infrastructure
  • Tourism, Heritage & Culture
  • Welfare of All
  • Urban Resilience & Disaster Management

Open Innovation Track:

Every category remains open beyond the listed challenges. Participants may propose any relevant idea within the same theme, even if it is not explicitly listed among the problem statements.
